title: Russian strikes on processing plants drive up Ukraine rapeseed export prices
summary: Rapeseed export prices in Ukraine rose by UAH 500-1,000 per tonne over the past week after Russian strikes on processing facilities disrupted oilseed processing operations.

title: Debris of Russian Gerbera-2 drone found in Moldova
summary: Debris from a Russian Gerbera-2-type drone was discovered near the village of Naslavcea in Moldova's Ocnița district.

title: Russian strikes on energy infrastructure cause power outages in five regions
summary: Russian forces attacked power generation facilities and electricity transmission and distribution infrastructure over the past 24 hours. As of the morning, consumers in the Dnipropetrovsk, Zhytomyr, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv and Sumy regions remained without electricity.

title: Russian forces attack Shostka, damaging four apartment buildings
summary: Russian drones have struck civilian infrastructure in Shostka, Sumy region, destroying non-residential premises and damaging four apartment buildings.

title: Drone attack reported on Kaleykino oil pumping station in Russia's Tatarstan
summary: Residents of Almetyevsk in Russia's Tatarstan region recorded flashes near the village of Kaleykino, where an oil pumping station of the Russian trunk oil pipeline system of the same name is located. Local authorities confirmed a drone attack on oil storage tanks.

title: Trump proposes Xi join talks with Putin on ending war in Ukraine
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump told Chinese President Xi Jinping at a meeting in Shenzhen that the two leaders should work together to end Russia's war in Ukraine and discuss the issue at a summit with Russian ruler Vladimir Putin.

title: U.S. dollar and euro exchange rates on November 19
summary: The U.S. dollar and the euro both fell by UAH 0.14 and UAH 0.28, respectively.

title: Russian forces strike industrial and energy infrastructure in Odesa region overnight
summary: Russian forces launched a massive combined attack on the south of the Odesa region overnight on November 19, damaging industrial and energy infrastructure facilities.

title: Ukraine approves drinking water supply improvement program through 2035
summary: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers has approved a state targeted program to improve drinking water supply through 2035.

title: Trump holds ‘pull-aside’ talks with Putin in China
summary: A meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian ruler Vladimir Putin in China ended after approximately 40 minutes.

title: Four people injured in Russian drone attacks on two districts of Kyiv region over past day
summary: Russian forces attacked the Vyshhorod and Fastiv districts of the Kyiv region with attack drones over the past day, injuring four people.

title: Zelensky discusses investment promotion and business innovation with Markarova
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed investment and business innovation measures aimed at strengthening Ukraine's economic resilience with Oksana Markarova, an adviser on reconstruction and investment.

title: War update: 211 attacks on front lines over past day, most on Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka axes
summary: On November 19, a total of 211 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invading forces were recorded along the front line, with the largest number of Russian attacks on the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka axes.

title: Train services on Crimean Bridge suspended after overnight drone attack – media
summary: Train services on the Kerch Strait Bridge have been temporarily suspended.

title: Zelensky announces measures to help unblock agricultural exports
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced measures aimed at helping unblock agricultural exports.

title: Air defense downs 69 drones launched by Russia in overnight attack on Ukraine
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 69 of the 98 drones Russia used to attack Ukraine from the evening of November 18.

title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure in Mykolaiv region
summary: Russian drones have attacked energy and civilian infrastructure in the Mykolaiv region, leaving 99 settlements without electricity.

title: Russia’s war casualty toll up by 1,970 over past day
summary: Russian forces have suffered approximately 1,630,980 combat losses since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, to November 19, 2026, including 1,970 personnel killed or wounded in action over the past 24 hours.

title: Norway's foreign minister: Europe's security architecture worked well until Russia violated it
summary: Europe's current security architecture does not need to be revised, as it functioned properly until Russia violated it.

title: Lithuania's military aid to Ukraine will not decrease next year – defense minister
summary: Lithuania's military assistance to Ukraine will not decrease next year and will amount to 0.25% of the country's GDP.

title: Russian assault troops in Kherson region's island zone readily surrender – press officer
summary: Many Russian servicemen sent to storm the islands in the Dnipro River delta near Kherson readily surrender to Ukrainian forces.

title: Zelensky believes Trump and Xi could pressure Putin into ending Ukraine war
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky believes that the United States and China have enough influence to pressure Russian leader Vladimir Putin into ending the war.

title: Putin is lying again: Carney responds to claim that “sanctions are a thing of the past”
summary: Sanctions against Russia must remain in place until the war in Ukraine ends.

title: Ukrainian law enforcers, FBI expose hacking network that stole data and demanded multimillion-dollar ransoms
summary: The Ukrainian Prosecutor General’s Office, in cooperation with the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), has exposed an international criminal organization whose members carried out large-scale cyberattacks on foreign companies and demanded ransoms totaling more than $40 million.

title: 19-year-old woman suspected of murdering Colombian national who served in Ukrainian army
summary: A 19-year-old woman in Kyiv has been notified of suspicion of the intentional murder of a Colombian national who previously served in the Ukrainian Armed Forces.

title: Ukrainian military ready to conduct further civilian evacuations from occupied Kherson region – press officer
summary: Ukrainian military personnel are prepared to carry out further evacuations of civilians from temporarily occupied areas of the Kherson region, even if this allows Russian forces to reinforce their units.

title: Zelensky sees “huge chance” for peace if Washington turns up pressure on Putin
summary: How quickly Russia’s war against Ukraine can be brought to an end will depend largely on the United States’ willingness to put pressure on the Kremlin.

title: Kushner confirms: U.S. considering NATO Article 5-like security guarantees for Ukraine
summary: The United States is prepared to consider providing Ukraine with security guarantees modeled on Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty, but they must serve U.S. interests and form part of a broader package of security measures.

title: Kushner reports progress on security guarantees for Ukraine and postwar reconstruction
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner has said that talks with Ukraine and European partners have made progress on future security guarantees, Ukraine’s accession to the EU, and a postwar reconstruction plan.

title: Zelensky: Russia loses 2026 to Ukraine on battlefield but trying to take it out on civilians
summary: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Russia lost 2026 to Ukraine on the battlefield but, disregarding all rules of warfare, is trying to make up for it by targeting civilians with aerial terror.

title: Aggressor cannot dictate unrealistic security demands – Burnham
summary: Europe is clear about what it will and will not accept in negotiations on peace in Ukraine, while also standing firmly on Ukraine’s side.

title: Macron calls for four-way peace talks, reopens debate on Ukraine’s NATO membership
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has said that peace negotiations should involve Ukraine, Russia, the United States, and Europe. He also called for revisiting the question of Ukraine’s NATO membership as part of long-term European security.

title: Latvian diplomats to continue working in Ukraine despite Russian strikes – FM
summary: Latvian Foreign Minister Girts Jaunzems has said that Latvian diplomats will carry on their work in Ukraine despite Russian strikes on diplomatic missions in Ukrainian cities.

title: Merz outlines key conditions for peace deal with Russia, floats partial sanctions relief
summary: Any future peace agreement on Ukraine must be based on preserving its sovereignty, using the line of contact as the starting point for territorial negotiations, allowing it to pursue European integration, and providing strong security guarantees.

title: Ukrainian forces refute Russian claim of capturing Shylivka in Donetsk region
summary: The claim that Shylivka was allegedly captured by the Russian Typhoon assault unit is false.

title: Russia destroys 420 UOC churches, kills 25 priests since start of full-scale invasion
summary: During the invasion, Russian troops have destroyed 420 churches belonging to the Ukrainian Orthodox Church (UOC), killed 25 of its priests, and sentenced clergy members who refused to submit to Patriarch Kirill.

title: Austrian Embassy in Kyiv damaged in Russian attack
summary: The Embassy of Austria in Ukraine was damaged during a Russian drone attack on Kyiv.

title: Zelensky outlines key topics for Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin
summary: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said that the key topics at today’s Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin include covering Ukraine’s budget needs, strengthening air defense, and a winter package of ballistic missile interceptors.

title: Russian forces trying to advance toward Orikhiv in small infantry groups but fail – military
summary: Russian forces continue trying to advance toward Orikhiv in the Zaporizhzhia region, using small infantry groups to infiltrate Ukrainian positions. However, the Defense Forces detect and destroy the enemy in time, before they can reach the city, which remains under the control of Ukrainian defenders.

title: “Shenzhen is not the Yalta of Putin's dreams,” FM Sybiha says
summary: The meeting of the leaders of China, the United States and Russia in Shenzhen, China, failed to fulfill Putin’s hopes of returning to the era of the Yalta Conference. It is time for him to face reality and end the war against Ukraine, which he cannot win.

title: No cause for concern about Ukraine’s food security, minister says
summary: The Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food currently sees no risks to food security on the domestic market.

title: One killed, five injured in Russian drone attack on Kyiv, St. Volodymyr’s Cathedral damaged
summary: One person was killed and five others injured in a Russian drone attack on Kyiv. Windows at St. Volodymyr’s Cathedral were also damaged.

title: Putin comments on strikes on Kerch bridge for first time
summary: Russian ruler Vladimir Putin has commented for the first time on the strikes on the Kerch Bridge, saying that Russia will no longer negotiate an “energy truce” with Ukraine following the attacks.

title: Putin sets condition for European involvement in talks on war in Ukraine
summary: Russian ruler Vladimir Putin has said the Kremlin is ready to include European representatives in negotiations on Ukraine, but only after they come to Moscow to discuss their proposals.

title: Russian aircraft strike hits Myrne in Donetsk region, injuring elderly couple
summary: Russian forces carried out an airstrike on the settlement of Myrne in the Sloviansk community of the Donetsk region, injuring an elderly couple.

title: Woman killed, several injured in Russian drone attack on Kyiv region
summary: A woman was killed and a man injured in a Russian drone attack in the Bucha district of the Kyiv region.

title: Injury toll in Russian strike on Izium rises to 21, including four children
summary: The number of people injured in a Russian strike on an apartment building in Izium, Kharkiv region, has risen to 21, including four children.

title: Drone debris falls near three-story building in Kyiv’s Podilskyi district
summary: Debris from a Russian drone has been reported near a three-story building in Kyiv’s Podilskyi district.

title: Witkoff, Kushner arrive in Berlin for Coalition of the Willing summit
summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived at the German Federal Chancellery in Berlin for talks with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and to attend the Coalition of the Willing summit.

title: Chinese, US, Russian leaders adopt 'peace declaration,' make no mention of Ukraine
summary: The leaders of China, the United States and Russia have adopted a joint "peace declaration" at a trilateral summit, making no mention of Russia's war against Ukraine or the operation against Iran.

title: Russian strike destroys section of residential building in Izium, injures 16
summary: Russian forces have struck a residential building in Izium, Kharkiv region.

title: UK to provide Ukraine with more than 1,000 long-range drones
summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham will announce a new GBP 260 million (more than $342 million) military aid package for Ukraine on Thursday after arriving in Berlin for the Coalition of the Willing summit. The package includes long-range drones.

title: Neptune missile strike damages railway track on Crimean Bridge -- General Staff
summary: The General Staff of the Ukrainian Armed Forces has confirmed that Ukrainian Neptune missiles damaged the railway track on the Kerch Strait Bridge overnight on November 19.

title: Zelensky arrives in Berlin for Coalition of the Willing meeting
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in Berlin to take part in a meeting of the Coalition of the Willing.

title: Trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi and Putin held in Shenzhen
summary: A trilateral meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian ruler Vladimir Putin took place on Thursday on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China. According to the leaders, they discussed the war in Ukraine and nuclear arms control.

title: Russian forces strike residential building in Izium, two injured
summary: Russian forces have struck a residential building in Izium, Kharkiv region. Two people have been reported injured, and others may be trapped under the rubble.

title: Ukrainian Defense Forces strike Russian drone operators in occupied Kherson region
summary: The locations of Russian drone crews were identified in the temporarily occupied part of the Kherson region, and the Ukrainian Defense Forces carried out precision strikes against them.

title: Zelensky meets with Witkoff, Kushner and European national security advisers
summary: Volodymyr Zelensky met with U.S. presidential special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, as well as European national security advisers.

title: Zelensky meets with Merz to discuss financial support, stronger air defense
summary: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky continued his talks with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz in a bilateral meeting.

title: European Commission pledges to fast-track review of Ukraine’s emissions trading bill – Environment Ministry
summary: The European Commission has pledged to speed up its review of Ukraine’s draft law establishing a national greenhouse gas emissions trading system. Ukraine is awaiting an opinion on whether the legislation complies with EU directives.
